# Third-party files in this folder

These are hosted with the app so that pages don't load anything from Google Fonts or public CDNs. Only GitHub Pages (the app) and Supabase (the photos) are contacted.

| File | What it is | Version | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `supabase.js` | Supabase JavaScript client | 2.45.4 | MIT | npm `@supabase/supabase-js` |
| `jszip.min.js` | Builds the "save all" zip file | 3.10.1 | MIT (dual MIT / GPLv3) | npm `jszip` |
| `qrcode.min.js` | Draws the QR code for the phone page | 1.0.0 | MIT | qrcodejs by davidshimjs |
| `patrick-hand.woff2` | "Handwriting" text font (Latin characters) | Fontsource 5.0.8 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | Patrick Hand by Patrick Wagesreiter |
